title: Birchwood Camp

services.name: Rental
services.desc: Birchwood Camp offers overnight facilities for groups up to 100 people. We know that every group has different needs, so there is no “one size fits all” rental package; the options listed below are popular rental packages and may be a good fit for your group. The prices listed below are subject to change at any time and do not include all possible charges or discounts. We also offer facilities for day use, a variety of camping programs, and team-building experiences on our challenge course. services.name: Challenge Course
services.desc: Birchwood Camp offers dynamic experiential learning and team building experiences on our low-ropes Challenge Course. Consider taking advantage of one of our offerings below for your organization, sports team, youth group, school group, leadership team, staff retreat, leadership development program or business. Contact the camp office using the form below to schedule your challenge course session or to discuss the right experience for your group! NOTE: We generally require participants to be at least 12 years old. Regardless of age, all participants must fill out our Challenge Course Release Form. services.desc: This package is designed for mid-sized groups with 25 to 60 guests; a 25 guest minimum required. The Main Lodge package includes use of the main lodge as a meeting space (outside of meal times; meals are held in the Lodge and may be shared with other groups). Dining service is provided by Birchwood Camp for all groups
